rationale: The discourse has become a stable impasse: employee-side actors and the state insist on no closures, no compulsory redundancies, and binding 2030 guarantees, while management, owners, and investors still require a durable structural cost and capacity reset and keep closures/headcount cuts available. Round 4 added clarification and quantified framing, but no substantive movement on the core contested issues, so further unstructured rounds are likely to circle without resolving the conflict.
